description: No Brainers is a team of creative thinkers and problem-solvers passionate about innovation and space exploration. We're building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer to make space learning interactive, engaging, and accessible, inspiring the next generation of astronauts through fun, hands-on mission simulations.
summary:
The Problem
Beyond Low Earth Orbit, severe communication latency renders real-time consultations with Earth-based flight surgeons infeasible. Concurrently, astronauts endure microgravity fluid shifts, musculoskeletal demineralization, circadian disruption, and cumulative radiation exposure without an onboard physician, while conventional trackers inundate crews with raw telemetry devoid of actionable clinical context.
Our Solution: VitalOrbit
VitalOrbit is an autonomous, offline-first health monitoring and clinical decision-support platform engineered for space scientists and astronauts. Contextualized Telemetry: Correlates longitudinal vitals and sleep architecture with Mission Elapsed Time, cabin pressure (kPa) and radiation dosimetry (mSv) to distinguish physiological adaptation from acute pathology. Multi-Modal Diagnostics: Integrates contactless Face Scan (rPPG) cardiovascular screening, Lab OCR blood-panel digitization, Radiology AI imaging triage, and Space Ops readiness with an immediate Emergency Beacon protocol. Explainable Flight Surgeon AI: Evaluates biometric trends and symptoms, elucidates spaceflight physiology (e.g., microgravity serum calcium elevation or autonomic sleep debt), and prescribes countermeasures backed by "Why the AI said this" grounding transparency and clinical guardrails. Offline Resilience: Operates autonomously without Earth links via local persistence, Data Dossier exports and instant local purge.
details:
What It Does & How It Works (SOFTWARE) VitalOrbit is an offline-first health monitoring and clinical decision-support platform for space scientists and astronauts. It correlates longitudinal vitals and sleep data with Mission Elapsed Time, cabin pressure (kPa) and radiation dosimetry (mSv), paired with contactless Face Scan (rPPG) cardiovascular checks, Lab OCR blood-panel digitization, Radiology AI imaging triage, Space Ops readiness, and an Emergency Beacon protocol. Its Flight Surgeon AI analyzes biometric trends and symptoms, explains space physiology (e.g., microgravity serum calcium shifts or sleep debt), prescribes countermeasures, and shows "Why the AI said this" grounding transparency.

Benefits & Intended Impact Delivers zero-latency clinical autonomy and human-centered triage for non-physician crews when communication delays block Earth consultations, supported by local persistence, Data Dossier exports, and instant local purge.

Tools, Languages & Stack Built as a web application (TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and AI/OCR/rPPG diagnostic modules) designed for local offline execution and clinical safety guardrails.

Creativity & Team Considerations Instead of passive charts or gamification, we prioritized explainable AI grounding, multi-modal contactless diagnostics, and offline resilience for deep-space missions.
